inputs.text: The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) has issued a one-month ultimatum to the federal government to complete the renegotiation of the 2009 agreement for non-teaching university unions. These essential workers have endured years of being sidelined, their vital role in sustaining public universities dismissed amid deep-rooted systemic inequality and institutional neglect that always burdens labor most. If the government drags its feet, SSANU stands ready for an indefinite nationwide strike to demand real accountability. This action stems from resolutions at the union’s 54th National Executive Council and reflects the pressing need for structural reforms that center workers' rights while confronting the power imbalances allowing elites to thrive at the expense of the vulnerable staff who keep education accessible for everyone.
